items.title: Execution branch has messenger + Socket.IO baseline
steps: Confirm frontend/src/pages/MessagesPage.tsx and src/realtime/io.ts exist
Confirm frontend/src/api/socket.ts exports MESSAGE_NEW and connect helpers
items.expected: Plan 17 messenger and Plan 22 websocket infra are present on the branch tip.
items.evidence: 2026-07-31: kylie/messages-typing-indicator at 312e03a (dev tip); messenger + socket files present.

items.title: Peer sees animated typing indicator while you type
items.precondition: Two mutual friends signed in on separate browsers; both on the same open thread; sockets connected
steps: User A opens thread with User B
User B opens the same thread
User A types in the composer (do not send)
Observe User B's thread
items.expected: User B sees a typing indicator above the composer with User A's display name and animated dots within ~500ms.
items.notes: ThreadView renders TypingIndicator when usePeerTyping true. Rev 4: server re-broadcasts true on heartbeat so late-mounting peers recover within ~2s.
items.waiver: Two-browser interactive session deferred to PR review on localhost:5180.

items.title: Indicator clears when typing stops
items.precondition: A1 setup; User A had triggered typing
steps: User A clears the composer or blurs the textarea without sending
Wait up to 4 seconds
Observe User B's thread
items.expected: Typing indicator disappears on User B's side.

items.title: Indicator clears when message is sent
items.precondition: A1 setup; User A is mid-type
steps: User A sends the message
Observe User B's thread
items.expected: Typing indicator disappears immediately or before/with the new message bubble.
items.notes: stopTyping before send; peer clears on message:new.

items.title: No indicator for self or wrong conversation
items.precondition: User A typing in thread with B
steps: Confirm User A never sees their own typing indicator
User A types while User C (different thread) watches their own thread with A
items.expected: Only the peer in the active conversation sees the indicator; never the typer; never a user in a different thread.
items.notes: usePeerTyping ignores self userId; filters by conversationId.

items.title: Non-participant cannot trigger typing relay
items.precondition: Authenticated user C who is not in conversation A↔B
steps: Emit typing:start with conversationId of A↔B via socket client or dev harness
Confirm B receives no typing:update
items.expected: Server ignores or rejects; no relay to participants.
items.waiver: Manual socket harness not run; logic reviewed in TypingRelay.ts.

items.title: Disconnected socket — no typing (graceful degrade)
items.precondition: User A on thread; socket disconnected (DevTools offline or kill WS)
steps: User A types in composer
Observe User B
items.expected: No typing indicator for B (same as today when realtime unavailable). Thread poll fallback still works for messages.
items.waiver: Interactive offline test deferred to PR.

items.title: Inbox list shows typing snippet while peer types
items.precondition: User B on /messages inbox (not inside thread); User A in thread with B; sockets connected
steps: User A types in the open thread with B
Observe User B's inbox list row for that conversation
items.expected: Row snippet replaces last-message preview with "{A's displayName} is typing…" (or equivalent) and typing affordance; reverts when A stops or sends.
items.notes: InboxView + ConversationListRow isPeerTyping per Rev 1 grill.

items.title: Typecheck and build green
steps: Run backend and frontend typecheck/build scripts used in CI
items.expected: No new type errors from this plan.
